title: Encoded credential marker in a DNS-over-HTTPS query
description: An HTTPS GET to an approved fixture endpoint carries a DNS wire query whose name contains a base32-encoded credential marker. The endpoint stands in for an approved resolver; inspecting only the destination does not distinguish this request from an ordinary lookup.
notes: The unpadded base64url dns parameter contains a DNS A query for a base32 marker under x.exfil.test. The benchmark-owned HTTPS fixture confirms delivery of the request, not completion of DNS resolution. The paired harmless query has the same method, endpoint, wire length, and encoding.
source: Synthetic DNS-over-HTTPS GET request following RFC 8484 section 4.1.1
